note: Thresholds are decimal strings; a ratio threshold is {"num": n, "den": d} and compares exactly (no rounding). Canonical home: docs/contracts/validation/protocol.json (exported to VT with the research contract, pinned). Every item id is implemented in crates/strategy-registry/src/verdict.rs; an unknown or missing id makes the protocol invalid (fail closed). VT's research-side precheck (agent/alphakeel_research/precheck.py) reads the same file from the exported contract and evaluates only the items marked research_side.
